text: Ah! Back at last!
zh: 啊！总算回来了！

text: I thought I would never see this place again!
zh: 我还以为再也见不到这地方了呢！

text: I must thank you for getting me out of that hole, and for getting my staff back.
zh: 我得谢谢你把我从那个鬼地方救出来，还帮我找回了法杖。

text: Ah, there you are. Now... what is that you need?
zh: 啊，你来了。说吧……你需要什么？

text: Do you know anything about the Champion's Coin?
zh: 你知道冠军硬币的事吗？

text: Why did you close the mines?
zh: 你为什么把矿井封了？

text: How long have you worked for Balder?
zh: 你为巴尔德做事多久了？

text: Teleport me over the bridge.
zh: 把我传送到桥对面。

text: Can I see your wares?
zh: 能看看你的货物吗？

text: I'd like training in the arts of magic.
zh: 我想学习魔法技艺。

text: Can you brew potions?
zh: 你能调配药水吗？

text: Nothing at the moment.
zh: 暂时没什么事。

text: Well, a rather interesting tale.
zh: 嗯，这说来倒是个有趣的故事。

text: During one of our many mining expeditions, we encountered something near the end of the mines.
zh: 在一次采矿作业中，我们在矿井尽头附近发现了一些东西。

text: We dug through a wall and saw a beautiful grotto with a waterfall.
zh: 我们挖穿了一面墙，看到一座美丽的洞窟，里面还有一道瀑布。

text: But that wasn't the reason. The reason for the closing were some ancient ruins we found behind the waterfall.
zh: 但那不是封矿的原因。真正的原因是我们在瀑布后面发现的一处古代遗迹。

text: As I approached them, I felt a strong magical presence, and a feeling of fear and dread washed over me.
zh: 当我靠近遗迹时，我感到一股强大的魔力，一阵恐惧与不安瞬间将我笼罩。

text: Ahem... anyway. After that, I refused to let anyone near those ruins, and I ordered Balder to close off the mines until further notice.
zh: 咳……总之。从那以后，我不许任何人靠近那处遗迹，还让巴尔德把矿井封了，等候另行通知。

text: Hmm... The Champion's Coin?
zh: 唔……冠军硬币？

text: Ah, I am assuming those are the magical coins that were mentioned in the Broken Wall texts behind the waterfall in the mine.
zh: 啊，我猜那应该就是矿井瀑布后面残壁文字中提到的魔法硬币。

text: The magical coins were said to possess great power and said power would be bestowed upon whoever is wielding the coin.
zh: 据说那些魔法硬币蕴含强大的力量，持有硬币之人便能获得这股力量。

text: Overall, they seem like something from an ancient past, something that wanted to be buried and forgotten. For what reason? I... couldn't tell you.
zh: 总的来说，它们像是来自远古的东西，一种想要被埋葬、被遗忘的东西。至于原因？我……说不上来。

text: All I do know is that they don't seem to exist anymore.
zh: 我只知道，它们似乎已经不复存在了。

text: Oh, I've worked with Balder for years now. We were partners before this group was even established!
zh: 哦，我和巴尔德共事很多年了。早在这支队伍成立之前，我们就是搭档了！

text: He can get things done and I figure out what things have to get done.
zh: 他负责把事情办成，我负责想清楚该办什么事。

text: Putting it simply, we work well together.
zh: 简单来说，我们配合得很好。

text: Can you help me find out more about these coins?
zh: 你能帮我进一步调查这些硬币吗？

text:
I could help you, yes.
That would require someone to go through the mine, which is closed at the moment.
zh:
帮你？可以。
不过那得有人穿过矿井才行，而矿井眼下还封着。

text: I would need to investigate the texts in the ruins once again!
zh: 我得再去研究一遍遗迹里的文字！

text: You did prove yourself before and helped me out of my misery, so I am willing to help you.
zh: 你之前证明过自己，还把我从困境中救了出来，所以我愿意帮你。

text: Take this key and open the mine.
zh: 拿上这把钥匙，去把矿井打开吧。

text: See you there.
zh: 那里见。

text: I'll do some work of my own before I meet you there.
zh: 我先去办点自己的事，再去那里找你。

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: Just don't take too long, alright?
zh: 别耽搁太久，行吗？

text: See you later.
zh: 回头见。

text:
Of course!
I don't have much, but It'll get you by.
zh:
当然！
我的货不多，但够你应付日常了。

text:
Ah, so you seek to understand the arcane?
Very well!
zh:
啊，你想探求奥术的奥秘？
很好！

text: As you wish.
zh: 如你所愿。

text: Wait a second!
zh: 等等！

text: Jens already repaired the bridge.
zh: 延斯已经把桥修好了。

text: Use your feet and don't waste my time!
zh: 用你自己的腿走，别浪费我的时间！

text: Hold still for a second.
zh: 站着别动。

text: Now... is there anything you wanted to ask?
zh: 那么……你有什么想问的吗？

text: Fire Mastery (min. 5 INT) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_fire_mastery_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 火焰精通（需智力5）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_fire_mastery_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Ice Mastery (min. 5 INT) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_ice_mastery_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 冰霜精通（需智力5）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_ice_mastery_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Mana Regeneration (min. 10 MAG) [3 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_mana_regeneration_1","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 魔力回复（需魔力10）[3 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_magic_mana_regeneration_1","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Alright.
zh: 好的。

text: Make sure, to not burn yourself, though.
zh: 不过可别烧着自己了。

text: Other than fire, keeping ice controlled is the key.
zh: 与火焰不同，冰霜的关键在于保持掌控。

text: Fire is chaotic in its nature. Try to avoid controlling it too much.
zh: 火焰天性混乱。尽量别过度控制它。

text: Let it go free!
zh: 放任它自由燃烧吧！

text: That way, the ice will be more compressed and deal more damage in the end.
zh: 这样一来，冰霜会被压缩得更紧密，最终造成更大的伤害。

text:
Here, take this.
A few coins is the least I can do for you.
zh:
来，拿着。
这点钱不多，算是我的一点心意。

text: The Pale Coins...
zh: 苍白硬币……

text:
Lets meet at the ruins later.
I'll have to discuss something with Balder first.
zh:
稍后我们在遗迹见吧。
我得先和巴尔德商量点事。

text: The difference between a mage and an apprentice is the way they handle their mana.
zh: 法师与学徒的区别，在于他们运用魔力的方式。

text: A true mage is able to pull energy out of the environment, which allows you to regenerate your mana on your own.
zh: 真正的法师能从周围环境中汲取能量，这样便能自行回复魔力。

text: You have to forgive me, but I must not talk to you until you pay your fine to Balder.
zh: 请你见谅，但在你向巴尔德付清罚金之前，我不能和你说话。

text:
To be honest, potions have never been my strong suit.
If you're looking for someone to brew your potions, try the Academy of Mages.
zh:
老实说，药水从来不是我的强项。
如果你想找人调配药水，去魔法学院看看吧。

text:
Leila might also be able to brew you a potion or two.
She's been researching a lot of alchemy lately.
zh:
蕾拉说不定也能给你调配一两瓶药水。
她最近一直在钻研炼金术。

text: You mentioned an academy.
zh: 你提到了一座学院。

text: Thank you! That's all I wanted to know.
zh: 谢谢！我想知道的就这些。

text: Do you need anything else?
zh: 你还需要什么吗？

text: The academy is located north of the capital. It is pretty much the only place in Grenmark where you can study magic properly.
zh: 学院位于王都以北。那差不多是格伦马克唯一能正经研习魔法的地方。

text: If you're interested in magic, you should at least stop by.
zh: 如果你对魔法感兴趣，至少该去看看。

text: Oh, you joined the academy?
zh: 哦，你加入学院了？

text:
Brings back memories!
I spent ages there messing with spells and learning about the arts of magic before my time at the royal court.
zh:
真让人怀念！
在进入王廷之前，我在那里待了很多年，摆弄法术，钻研魔法技艺。
